scope: independent root audit of the p-adic normalization, all-depth exact-differential contradiction, coefficient carrier, rational Sturm/Cauchy bound, nonzero-row scope, de-overlap, and ledger interpretation

checks.root_repairs: Corrected the certificate's component-decrease sign and restricted the carrier and uniform c_m bound to nonzero rows, which the frozen saddle theorem supplies for all sufficiently large m. The asymptotic ceiling is unchanged.

mathematical_audit.normalization: For p>6m, all dyadic, M, T, K, and Cartier factors in the normalized coordinates are p-units, so v_p(c_m)=min(v_p(A_m),v_p(B_m)).
mathematical_audit.lower_valuation: If t=min(v_p(L0),v_p(L1)), p-integrality of all endpoint coordinates gives v_p(A_m),v_p(B_m)>=t.
mathematical_audit.strictness_contradiction: If both determinant coordinates had valuation greater than t, dividing L0,L1 by p^t would produce a nonzero mod-p linear combination with zero log, pi, and rational endpoint coordinates. Pole orders are below p and the form is proper, so it is exact. The frozen local argument at p=6m+1, and the degree comparison yielding 4a(4m+1)=0 for p>6m+1, both force the normalized log pair to vanish, a contradiction.
mathematical_audit.all_depth_identity: Therefore the minimum determinant valuation equals the minimum log-residue valuation at every p>6m, including multiplicity. Dyadic scaling turns this into the lambda0,lambda1 carrier identity.
mathematical_audit.height: Cauchy's bound factors each residue into the m-th power of r^-4 |(1-z)^6/(1+z^2)^4| and a fixed amplitude. The exact quartic P(c)=136 r^4 B(c)^2-A(c)^3 is positive on [-1,1], giving base below 136; the two amplitudes are below 3 and 21.
mathematical_audit.scope: The resulting limsup log(c_(m,>6m))/(6m)<=log(136)/6 is a strict large-prime component ceiling. It is not subtractable from the unknown small-prime factor and does not lower the current total-content fallback ceiling by itself.
mathematical_audit.de_overlap: The support p>6m is disjoint from the booked p<2m Cartier support and all clearing factors. Full valuations are already included, so higher p-adic digits at those primes cannot be rebooked. Beta residual matching remains a separate primitive-target question.

PROVED: actual all-depth saturation at every p>6m on nonzero rows
